title: openai/whisper: speech to text on your own machine
friendlyTitle: A speech-to-text model you can run yourself
summary: OpenAI's Whisper is a speech-recognition model that can transcribe speech, translate it, and identify the language. The repository picked up 123 stars on GitHub's daily Python trending list and has about 112,800 stars overall. It is released under the MIT license.
friendlySummary: Whisper is OpenAI's speech tool. It can write down what was said, translate speech, and name the language. The project gained 123 stars on GitHub's Python list today and has about 112,800 stars in all. The license is MIT.
whyItMatters: You can turn a recording into text on your own machine instead of sending every file to a cloud API. Use it for captions, notes, and search, then check names and numbers before you rely on the transcript.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it to turn a recording into text on your own computer, instead of uploading every file. It is useful for captions, notes, and search. Check names and numbers before you trust the transcript.
